verses.original: Καὶ εἰσῆλθεν πάλιν εἰς τὴν συναγωγήν καὶ ἦν ἐκεῖ ἄνθρωπος ἐξηραμμένην ἔχων τὴν χεῖρα
verses.transliteration: Kai eisēlthen palin eis tēn synagōgēn kai ēn ekei anthrōpos exērammenēn echōn tēn cheira
verses.literal: Once again Jesus entered . . . the synagogue and a man with a withered hand was there
verses.literalPt: E OUTRA vez entrou na sinagoga, e estava ali um homem que tinha uma das mãos mirrada.

verses.original: καὶ παρετήρουν αὐτὸν εἰ τοῖς σάββασιν θεραπεύσει αὐτόν ἵνα κατηγορήσωσιν αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai paretēroun auton ei tois sabbasin therapeusei auton hina katēgorēsōsin autou
verses.literal: In order to accuse Jesus they were watching to see if He would heal on the Sabbath
verses.literalPt: E estavam observando-o se curaria no sábado, para o acusarem.

verses.original: Καὶ λέγει τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ τῷ τὴν χεῖρα ἔχοντι ξηράν Ἔγειρε εἰς τὸ μέσον
verses.transliteration: Kai legei tō anthrōpō tō tēn cheira echonti xēran Egeire eis to meson
verses.literal: Then Jesus said to the man with the withered hand Stand up among us
verses.literalPt: E disse ao homem que tinha a mão mirrada: Levanta-te e vem para o meio.

verses.original: καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Ἔξεστιν τοῖς σάββασιν ἀγαθὸν¦ποιῆσαι ἢ κακοποιῆσαι ψυχὴν σῶσαι ἢ ἀποκτεῖναι Οἱ δὲ ἐσιώπων
verses.transliteration: kai legei autois Exestin tois sabbasin agathon¦poiēsai ē kakopoiēsai psychēn sōsai ē apokteinai Hoi de esiōpōn
verses.literal: And He asked them Which is lawful on the Sabbath to do good or to do evil to save life or to destroy it But they were silent
verses.literalPt: E perguntou-lhes: É lícito no sábado fazer bem, ou fazer mal? salvar a vida, ou matar? E eles calaram-se.

verses.original: Καὶ περιβλεψάμενος αὐτοὺς μετ’ ὀργῆς συλλυπούμενος ἐπὶ τῇ πωρώσει τῆς καρδίας αὐτῶν λέγει τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ Ἔκτεινον τὴν χεῖρα σου καὶ ἐξέτεινεν καὶ ἀπεκατεστάθη ἡ χεὶρ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai periblepsamenos autous met’ orgēs syllypoumenos epi tē pōrōsei tēs kardias autōn legei tō anthrōpō Ekteinon tēn cheira sou kai exeteinen kai apekatestathē hē cheir autou
verses.literal: Jesus looked around at them with anger and sorrow at their hardness of heart Then He said to the man Stretch out your hand So he stretched it out and it was restored
verses.literalPt: E, olhando para eles em redor com indignação, condoendo-se da dureza do seu coração, disse ao homem: Estende a tua mão. E ele a estendeu, e foi-lhe restituída a sua mão, sã como a outra.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐξελθόντες οἱ Φαρισαῖοι εὐθὺς μετὰ τῶν Ἡρῳδιανῶν συμβούλιον ἐδίδουν κατ’ αὐτοῦ ὅπως αὐτὸν ἀπολέσωσιν
verses.transliteration: Kai exelthontes hoi Pharisaioi euthys meta tōn Hērōdianōn symboulion edidoun kat’ autou hopōs auton apolesōsin
verses.literal: At this . . . the Pharisees went out and began plotting . . . with the Herodians - how they might kill Jesus
verses.literalPt: E, tendo saído os fariseus, tomaram logo conselho com os herodianos contra ele, procurando ver como o matariam.

verses.original: Καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς μετὰ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ ἀνεχώρησεν πρὸς τὴν θάλασσαν καὶ πολὺ πλῆθος ἀπὸ τῆς Γαλιλαίας ἠκολούθησεν καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς Ἰουδαίας
verses.transliteration: Kai ho Iēsous meta tōn mathētōn autou anechōrēsen pros tēn thalassan kai poly plēthos apo tēs Galilaias ēkolouthēsen kai apo tēs Ioudaias
verses.literal: So Jesus withdrew with His disciples to the sea accompanied by a large crowd from Galilee - Judea
verses.literalPt: E retirou-se Jesus com os seus discípulos para o mar, e seguia-o uma grande multidão da Galiléia e da Judéia,

verses.original: καὶ ἀπὸ Ἱεροσολύμων καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς Ἰδουμαίας καὶ πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου καὶ περὶ Τύρον καὶ Σιδῶνα πλῆθος πολύ ἀκούοντες ὅσα ἐποίει ἦλθον πρὸς αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: kai apo Hierosolymōn kai apo tēs Idoumaias kai peran tou Iordanou kai peri Tyron kai Sidōna plēthos poly akouontes hosa epoiei ēlthon pros auton
verses.literal: Jerusalem - Idumea the region beyond the Jordan and the vicinity of Tyre and Sidon The large crowd came to Him when they heard what great things He was doing
verses.literalPt: E de Jerusalém, e da Iduméia, e de além do Jordão, e de perto de Tiro e de Sidom; uma grande multidão que, ouvindo quão grandes coisas fazia, vinha ter com ele.

verses.original: Καὶ εἶπεν τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ ἵνα πλοιάριον προσκαρτερῇ αὐτῷ διὰ τὸν ὄχλον ἵνα μὴ θλίβωσιν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Kai eipen tois mathētais autou hina ploiarion proskarterē autō dia ton ochlon hina mē thlibōsin auton
verses.literal: Jesus asked His disciples to have a boat ready for Him so that the crowd would not crush Him
verses.literalPt: E ele disse aos seus discípulos que lhe tivessem sempre pronto um barquinho junto dele, por causa da multidão, para que o não oprimisse,

verses.original: πολλοὺς γὰρ ἐθεράπευσεν ὥστε ἐπιπίπτειν αὐτῷ ἵνα αὐτοῦ ἅψωνται ὅσοι εἶχον μάστιγας
verses.transliteration: pollous gar etherapeusen hōste epipiptein autō hina autou hapsōntai hosoi eichon mastigas
verses.literal: For He had healed so many that all who had diseases were pressing forward to touch Him
verses.literalPt: Porque tinha curado a muitos, de tal maneira que todos quantos tinham algum mal se arrojavam sobre ele, para lhe tocarem.

verses.original: καὶ τὰ πνεύματα τὰ ἀκάθαρτα ὅταν αὐτὸν ἐθεώρουν προσέπιπτον αὐτῷ καὶ ἔκραζον λέγοντα ὅτι Σὺ εἶ ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai ta pneumata ta akatharta hotan auton etheōroun prosepipton autō kai ekrazon legonta hoti Sy ei ho Huios tou Theou
verses.literal: And when the unclean spirits saw Him they fell down before Him and cried out - You are the Son of God
verses.literalPt: E os espíritos imundos vendo-o, prostravam-se diante dele, e clamavam, dizendo: Tu és o Filho de Deus.

verses.original: καὶ πολλὰ ἐπετίμα αὐτοῖς ἵνα μὴ αὐτὸν φανερὸν ποιήσωσιν
verses.transliteration: kai polla epetima autois hina mē auton phaneron poiēsōsin
verses.literal: But He warned them sternly not to make Him known
verses.literalPt: E ele os ameaçava muito, para que não o manifestassem.

verses.original: Καὶ ἀναβαίνει εἰς τὸ ὄρος καὶ προσκαλεῖται οὓς ἤθελεν αὐτός καὶ ἀπῆλθον πρὸς αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Kai anabainei eis to oros kai proskaleitai hous ēthelen autos kai apēlthon pros auton
verses.literal: Then Jesus went up on the mountain and called for those He wanted and they came to Him
verses.literalPt: E subiu ao monte, e chamou para si os que ele quis; e vieram a ele.

verses.original: καὶ ἐποίησεν δώδεκα οὓς καὶ ἀποστόλους ὠνόμασεν ἵνα ὦσιν μετ’ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἵνα ἀποστέλλῃ αὐτοὺς κηρύσσειν
verses.transliteration: kai epoiēsen dōdeka hous kai apostolous ōnomasen hina ōsin met’ autou kai hina apostellē autous kēryssein
verses.literal: He appointed twelve of them whom He designated as apostles to accompany . . . Him to be sent out to preach
verses.literalPt: E nomeou doze para que estivessem com ele e os mandasse a pregar,

verses.original: καὶ ἔχειν ἐξουσίαν ἐκβάλλειν τὰ δαιμόνια
verses.transliteration: kai echein exousian ekballein ta daimonia
verses.literal: and to have authority to drive out demons
verses.literalPt: E para que tivessem o poder de curar as enfermidades e expulsar os demônios:

verses.original: Καὶ ἐποίησεν τοὺς δώδεκα καὶ ἐπέθηκεν ὄνομα τῷ Σίμωνι Πέτρον
verses.transliteration: Kai epoiēsen tous dōdeka kai epethēken onoma tō Simōni Petron
verses.literal: These are the twelve He appointed - Simon (whom He named Peter)
verses.literalPt: A Simão, a quem pôs o nome de Pedro,

verses.original: καὶ Ἰάκωβον τὸν τοῦ Ζεβεδαίου καὶ Ἰωάννην τὸν ἀδελφὸν τοῦ Ἰακώβου καὶ ἐπέθηκεν αὐτοῖς ὀνόματα Βοανηργές ὅ ἐστιν Υἱοὶ Βροντῆς
verses.transliteration: kai Iakōbon ton tou Zebedaiou kai Iōannēn ton adelphon tou Iakōbou kai epethēken autois onomata Boanērges ho estin Huioi Brontēs
verses.literal: James son of Zebedee and - his brother John ( whom He named Boanerges meaning Sons of Thunder
verses.literalPt: E a Tiago, filho de Zebedeu, e a João, irmão de Tiago, aos quais pôs o nome de Boanerges, que significa: Filhos do trovão;

verses.original: καὶ Ἀνδρέαν καὶ Φίλιππον καὶ Βαρθολομαῖον καὶ Μαθθαῖον καὶ Θωμᾶν καὶ Ἰάκωβον τὸν τοῦ Ἁλφαίου καὶ Θαδδαῖον καὶ Σίμωνα τὸν Καναναῖον
verses.transliteration: kai Andrean kai Philippon kai Bartholomaion kai Maththaion kai Thōman kai Iakōbon ton tou Halphaiou kai Thaddaion kai Simōna ton Kananaion
verses.literal: Andrew Philip Bartholomew Matthew Thomas James son of Alphaeus Thaddaeus Simon the Zealot
verses.literalPt: E a André, e a Filipe, e a Bartolomeu, e a Mateus, e a Tomé, e a Tiago, filho de Alfeu, e a Tadeu, e a Simão o Zelote,

verses.original: καὶ Ἰούδαν Ἰσκαριώθ ὃς καὶ παρέδωκεν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: kai Ioudan Iskariōth hos kai paredōken auton
verses.literal: and Judas Iscariot who betrayed Jesus
verses.literalPt: E a Judas Iscariotes, o que o entregou.

verses.original: Καὶ ἔρχεται εἰς οἶκον καὶ συνέρχεται πάλιν ὁ ὄχλος ὥστε μὴ δύνασθαι αὐτοὺς μηδὲ ἄρτον φαγεῖν
verses.transliteration: Kai erchetai eis oikon kai synerchetai palin ho ochlos hōste mē dynasthai autous mēde arton phagein
verses.literal: Then Jesus went home and once again a crowd gathered so that He and His disciples could not even eat
verses.literalPt: E foram para uma casa. E afluiu outra vez a multidão, de tal maneira que nem sequer podiam comer pão.

verses.original: καὶ ἀκούσαντες οἱ παρ’ αὐτοῦ ἐξῆλθον κρατῆσαι αὐτόν ἔλεγον γὰρ ὅτι Ἐξέστη
verses.transliteration: kai akousantes hoi par’ autou exēlthon kratēsai auton elegon gar hoti Exestē
verses.literal: When His family . . . heard about this they went out to take custody of Him saying He is out of His mind
verses.literalPt: E, quando os seus ouviram isto, saíram para o prender; porque diziam: Está fora de si.

verses.original: Καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς οἱ ἀπὸ Ἱεροσολύμων καταβάντες ἔλεγον ὅτι Βεελζεβοὺλ ἔχει καὶ ὅτι Ἐν τῷ ἄρχοντι τῶν δαιμονίων ἐκβάλλει τὰ δαιμόνια
verses.transliteration: Kai hoi grammateis hoi apo Hierosolymōn katabantes elegon hoti Beelzeboul echei kai hoti En tō archonti tōn daimoniōn ekballei ta daimonia
verses.literal: And the scribes who had come down from Jerusalem were saying He is possessed by Beelzebul and By the prince of the demons He drives out demons
verses.literalPt: E os escribas, que tinham descido de Jerusalém, diziam: Tem Belzebu, e pelo príncipe dos demônios expulsa os demônios.

verses.original: Καὶ προσκαλεσάμενος αὐτοὺς ἐν παραβολαῖς ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς Πῶς δύναται Σατανᾶς Σατανᾶν ἐκβάλλειν
verses.transliteration: Kai proskalesamenos autous en parabolais elegen autois Pōs dynatai Satanas Satanan ekballein
verses.literal: So Jesus called them together . . . and began to speak to them in parables How can Satan drive out Satan
verses.literalPt: E, chamando-os a si, disse-lhes por parábolas: Como pode Satanás expulsar Satanás?

verses.original: καὶ ἐὰν βασιλεία ἐφ’ ἑαυτὴν μερισθῇ οὐ δύναται σταθῆναι ἡ βασιλεία ἐκείνη
verses.transliteration: kai ean basileia eph’ heautēn meristhē ou dynatai stathēnai hē basileia ekeinē
verses.literal: If a kingdom is divided against itself it cannot stand
verses.literalPt: E, se um reino se dividir contra si mesmo, tal reino não pode subsistir;

verses.original: καὶ ἐὰν οἰκία ἐφ’ ἑαυτὴν μερισθῇ οὐ δυνήσεται ἡ οἰκία ἐκείνη σταθῆναι
verses.transliteration: kai ean oikia eph’ heautēn meristhē ou dynēsetai hē oikia ekeinē stathēnai
verses.literal: If a house is divided against itself it cannot stand
verses.literalPt: E, se uma casa se dividir contra si mesma, tal casa não pode subsistir.

verses.original: καὶ εἰ ὁ Σατανᾶς ἀνέστη ἐφ’ ἑαυτὸν καὶ ἐμερίσθη οὐ δύναται στῆναι ἀλλὰ τέλος ἔχει
verses.transliteration: kai ei ho Satanas anestē eph’ heauton kai emeristhē ou dynatai stēnai alla telos echei
verses.literal: And if Satan is divided and rises against himself he cannot stand his end has come
verses.literalPt: E, se Satanás se levantar contra si mesmo, e for dividido, não pode subsistir; antes tem fim.

verses.original: ἀλλ’ οὐ δύναται οὐδεὶς εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν τοῦ ἰσχυροῦ εἰσελθὼν τὰ σκεύη αὐτοῦ διαρπάσαι ἐὰν μὴ πρῶτον τὸν ἰσχυρὸν δήσῃ καὶ τότε τὴν οἰκίαν αὐτοῦ διαρπάσει
verses.transliteration: all’ ou dynatai oudeis eis tēn oikian tou ischyrou eiselthōn ta skeuē autou diarpasai ean mē prōton ton ischyron dēsē kai tote tēn oikian autou diarpasei
verses.literal: Indeed no one . . . can enter . . . a strong man’s house to steal his possessions unless . . . he first ties up the strong man Then he can plunder his house
verses.literalPt: Ninguém pode roubar os bens do valente, entrando-lhe em sua casa, se primeiro não maniatar o valente; e então roubará a sua casa.

verses.original: Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι πάντα ἀφεθήσεται τοῖς υἱοῖς τῶν ἀνθρώπων τὰ ἁμαρτήματα καὶ αἱ βλασφημίαι ὅσα ἐὰν βλασφημήσωσιν
verses.transliteration: Amēn legō hymin hoti panta aphethēsetai tois huiois tōn anthrōpōn ta hamartēmata kai hai blasphēmiai hosa ean blasphēmēsōsin
verses.literal: Truly I tell you the sons of men will be forgiven all sins and blasphemies as many as they utter
verses.literalPt: Na verdade vos digo que todos os pecados serão perdoados aos filhos dos homens, e toda a sorte de blasfêmias, com que blasfemarem;

verses.original: ὃς δ’ ἂν βλασφημήσῃ εἰς τὸ Πνεῦμα τὸ Ἅγιον οὐκ ἔχει ἄφεσιν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ἀλλὰ ἔνοχός ἐστιν αἰωνίου ἁμαρτήματος
verses.transliteration: hos d’ an blasphēmēsē eis to Pneuma to Hagion ouk echei aphesin eis ton aiōna alla enochos estin aiōniou hamartēmatos
verses.literal: But whoever . . . blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will never . . . . . . . . . be forgiven he is guilty of eternal sin
verses.literalPt: Qualquer, porém, que blasfemar contra o Espírito Santo, nunca obterá perdão, mas será réu do eterno juízo

verses.original: Ὅτι ἔλεγον Πνεῦμα ἀκάθαρτον ἔχει
verses.transliteration: Hoti elegon Pneuma akatharton echei
verses.literal: Jesus made this statement because they were saying He has an unclean spirit
verses.literalPt: (Porque diziam: Tem espírito imundo).

verses.original: Καὶ ἔρχονται ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔξω στήκοντες ἀπέστειλαν πρὸς αὐτὸν καλοῦντες αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Kai erchontai hē mētēr autou kai hoi adelphoi autou kai exō stēkontes apesteilan pros auton kalountes auton
verses.literal: Then Jesus’ mother and - brothers came and stood outside They sent someone in to summon Him
verses.literalPt: Chegaram, então, seus irmãos e sua mãe; e, estando fora, mandaram-no chamar.

verses.original: καὶ ἐκάθητο περὶ αὐτὸν ὄχλος καὶ λέγουσιν αὐτῷ Ἰδοὺ ἡ μήτηρ σου καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοί σου ἔξω ζητοῦσίν σε
verses.transliteration: kai ekathēto peri auton ochlos kai legousin autō Idou hē mētēr sou kai hoi adelphoi sou exō zētousin se
verses.literal: and a crowd was sitting around Him Look He was told . . . Your mother and - brothers are outside asking for You
verses.literalPt: E a multidão estava assentada ao redor dele, e disseram-lhe: Eis que tua mãe e teus irmãos te procuram, e estão lá fora.

verses.original: Καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς αὐτοῖς λέγει Τίς ἐστιν ἡ μήτηρ μου καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοί μου
verses.transliteration: Kai apokritheis autois legei Tis estin hē mētēr mou kai hoi adelphoi mou
verses.literal: But Jesus replied - Who are My mother and My brothers
verses.literalPt: E ele lhes respondeu, dizendo: Quem é minha mãe e meus irmãos?

verses.original: καὶ περιβλεψάμενος τοὺς περὶ αὐτὸν κύκλῳ καθημένους λέγει Ἴδε ἡ μήτηρ μου καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοί μου
verses.transliteration: kai periblepsamenos tous peri auton kyklō kathēmenous legei Ide hē mētēr mou kai hoi adelphoi mou
verses.literal: Looking at those seated in a circle around Him He said Here are My mother and My brothers
verses.literalPt: E, olhando em redor para os que estavam assentados junto dele, disse: Eis aqui minha mãe e meus irmãos.

verses.original: ὃς γὰρ ἂν ποιήσῃ τὸ θέλημα τοῦ Θεοῦ οὗτος ἀδελφός μου καὶ ἀδελφὴ καὶ μήτηρ ἐστίν
verses.transliteration: hos gar an poiēsē to thelēma tou Theou houtos adelphos mou kai adelphē kai mētēr estin
verses.literal: For whoever . . . does the will of God is My brother and sister and mother
verses.literalPt: Porquanto, qualquer que fizer a vontade de Deus, esse é meu irmão, e minha irmã, e minha mãe.
